data.description: 【伊冯 · 宿舍打机】基地宿舍的深夜，伊冯窝在电竞椅里打联机游戏，时尚休闲装被空调吹得懒洋洋，屏幕光把她的侧脸照成一片蓝粉——「这把打完绝对上分……什么？维修报告？明天再说！」
data.promptProse: At midnight in the base dormitory, Yvonne curls into her gaming chair and works the controls with her polished fingertips, absorbed in an online match. Preserve her cream cardigan with coral edging, navy T-shirt, charcoal midi skirt and opaque tights in a medium view from beside the desk. The angled monitor overlaps the near edge of her shoulder, and the desk surface runs past the keyboard toward the rear wall; the chair back separates her from the darker room. Blue-and-pink screen light falls on her cheek, twin tails and operating hand. The existing night lamp picks out the chair rim and a narrow strip of desktop, while the monitor stand casts a low shadow across the desk.
data.title: 伊冯 · 宿舍打机
